title: 第十七章在这惨烈的三国战场上新书求推荐票求月票求收藏第十八章王璃 我满脑子就只想着学习新书求推荐票求月票求收藏
slug: 这年头谁还不是个武者啊
content_zh:
第十七章在这惨烈的三国战场上……【新书求推荐票，求月票，求收藏】
“不知所谓！”
一位跨骑着宝驹白马的诸侯，手提一杆烂银长枪，在王璃嘎嘎怪笑之际，单马银枪突冲而来。
这不是有幽州第一的公孙瓒又是哪位。
当真是说不出，言不尽的风姿绰约，姿仪勃发。
“走你！”
只可惜，王璃同学初来乍到，这副本世界的具体人名，他连半个都不知道，光看面相，他哪里知道谁是谁？
他就只见一个穿着白袍银盔，身骑白马的俊美武将朝自己冲击而来。
猛地那么一看，王同学还以为是见到了未来的那位“子龙武圣”
，神情激动下上去就飞身一脚。
黑铁色的磅礴气焰，裹挟着王璃直接化成一道光。
公孙瓒根本为来及回神，只条件反射的将烂银长枪拦挡在身前，然后他就被“光”
生生踢了一脚。
肉眼可见，他的长枪变成了“U”
形，然后连人带马直接化成天空上的一颗流星。
“凶徒休走…走……走…走？？？”
根本就没理解现场究竟发生了什么的河内太守王匡，带着部将方悦一样冲来，明明还跟在公孙瓒身后。
可结果王匡的狠话还没说完，公孙瓒就已经化成了天际线上死兆星，在他的头顶闪耀。
王匡勒住宝马，想要往后推可是在他身后的上党太守张杨，还有他的部将穆顺，手握瓮鼓金锤的北海太守孔融部将武安国，在齐齐往前冲，直接就被裹挟到了王璃身前。
然后……大家面面相窥，相互眨眨眼。

王璃：“●°u°●?？嗯！”
王匡：“?Д??”
在场众人：“???…啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！”
“第五感”
的拳锋下，那已经撕裂成一条条丝线状天空上，这一瞬间就有多了几颗星。
“我有悍将刘三刀可斩此撩！”
“可惜我颜良文丑不在，但贼子莫狂，我冢中骷髅王袁公路来会会你！”
“我袁家华南虎、淮南虎、剑齿虎、爪哇虎、跳跳虎这就来会会你！”
“江都猛虎孙文台，还请赐教！”
“嘚，那贼子！
吾乃燕人张翼德，吾来与你一战！”
“酒且斟下，关某去去便来！”
连天营帐，接连不断响起一个又一個顶级武将的声音。
有王璃熟悉的，也有不熟悉的，有的甚至是在历史书上都需要用几十页纸来记载的绝代风华的人物。
但对于王同学而言…都是不相干的！
但王璃是那种喜欢慣着别人的人吗？
正所谓现实世界里我唯唯诺诺，副本世界里我重拳出击。
圣斗士的小宇宙力量一入脑，那就跟什么什么似的，什么时候轮到“热血”
以外的东西，去占领智商高地了？
content_en:
Chapter 17 On this tragic battlefield of the Three Kingdoms... [Please recommend votes for new books, monthly votes, and collections]
"I don't know what it means!"
A prince was riding a precious white horse, carrying a rotten silver spear. When Wang Li was laughing strangely, the single-horse silver spear rushed over.
This is Gongsun Zan, who is the number one in Youzhou.
It's really indescribable, indescribable, graceful and graceful.
"Let's go!"
It's a pity that classmate Wang Li has just arrived. He doesn't even know half of the specific names of the people in this world. How can he know who is who just by looking at their faces?
He saw a handsome general wearing a white robe and a silver helmet and riding a white horse charging towards him.
With a sudden look, classmate Wang thought he had seen the future "Zilong Martial Saint"
, looking excited, he went up and kicked.
The majestic black iron-colored flames enveloped Wang Li and turned into a beam of light.
Gongsun Zan didn't have time to recover, so he reflexively blocked the rotten silver spear in front of him, and then he was "lighted"
A sharp kick.
Visible to the naked eye, his spear turned into a "U"
shape, and then the man and the horse turned directly into a shooting star in the sky.
"The murderer should leave...go...go...go???"
Wang Kuang, the prefect of Hanoi, who did not understand what happened at the scene, rushed over with his general Fang Yue, obviously still following Gongsun Zan.
But before Wang Kuang could finish his harsh words, Gongsun Zan turned into a death omen star on the skyline, shining above his head.
Wang Kuang restrained the BMW and wanted to push it back, but Zhang Yang, the governor of Shangdang, and his general Mu Shun, who were behind him, and Wu Anguo, the general of Beihai governor Kong Rong who was holding a urn, drum and golden hammer, all rushed forward and were directly held in front of Wang Li.
Then... everyone looked at each other and winked at each other.
Wang Li: "●°u°●?? Yeah!"
Wang Kuang: "?Д??"
Everyone present: "???...Ahhhhhhhhhh!"
"Fifth Sense"
Under his fist, the sky had been torn into threads, and at this moment there were a few more stars.
"I have the warrior Liu Sandao who can kill this tease!"
"It's a pity that I, Yan Liangwen Chou, am not here, but you thief are not crazy. I, the Skeleton King of the Tomb, Yuan Gongluo, have come to meet you!"
"I, the Yuan family's South China tiger, Huainan tiger, saber-toothed tiger, Javan tiger, and Tigger are here to meet you!"
"Jiangdu Tiger Sun Wentai, please give me some advice!"
"Hey, that thief!
I am Zhang Yide from Yan, and I come to fight with you! "
"Pour down the wine. Guan will come as soon as you go!"
The voices of top military commanders sounded one after another in the tents all over the sky.
There were some that Wang Li was familiar with, some that he was not familiar with, and some that even required dozens of pages to be recorded in history books.
But for Mr. Wang... they are irrelevant!
But is Wang Li the kind of person who likes to spoil others?
As the saying goes, in the real world I am submissive, but in the copy world I attack hard.
Once the Saint Seiya's small cosmic power enters the brain, it's like, when will it be the turn of "hot blood"?
Are you going to occupy the IQ high ground with something other than that?
